name: DBR Saturday Race
description:
Welcome to DBR Saturday Race.

All RS categories will start at the same time. Expect each race to be highly competitive and have fun.

Categories
Each race will be using Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) for categorization.
race up a category, if your RS is at the top end of a category. Or if you simply desire an added challenge.

- A: 1000 =< 690
- B:690<520
- C:520<350
- D:350<180
- E:180<=0

Your Zwift Racing Score is determined by how much success you have in races.
better against people with higher ZRS, then your ZRS may increase. If you place worse than people with lower ZRS, then your score might decrease. Read more about ZRS here - https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh <https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh>

If your ZRS increases past a category boundary during the series, your points earned will not transfer to the new category with you.

RULES:
Smart trainer or power meter is required. zPower will be removed.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for all categories.
No TT bikes unless it's a TT event.
You need to have a registered account with Zwiftpower.com and accept their terms and conditions to be in the results of the race.

Misc.
Race organizers may request riders in all categories to provide a dual recording or a matching RL effort (Strava) in order to verify a Zwift race effort. Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. Failure to provide a dual recording or RL effort on three requests may result in disqualification from future events, until a dual recording with a matching effort is provided.
Race organizers may exclude a rider from the results, due to poor sportsmanship. Examples may be bad language, sandbagging or other behavior of a disruptive manner.

name: Team CLS Base 'n' Banter
description:
Base ’n’ Banter is a controlled weekend endurance ride - with a strong community and social focus! 

Across every weekend in 2026, we will continue to offer a mix of rides that cover flat, rolling and hilly terrain with the aim of getting in a solid endurance ride, mostly around 2hrs.

This is a chance to enjoy a friendly experienced group club ride with regulars who have no Big Egos. While you build your fitness, there is always plenty of in-ride banter. 

What pace to expect?
We will ride the flats around 2.5 - 2.7 w/kg with a focus on keeping everyone together!

The leader will climb at around 3.0 - 3.2 w/kg depending on the length and if needed we will always try and regroup after.

While the leader will do everything to keep everyone together, we can't slow repeatedly so some splits are inevitable.

Our SWEEPERS on this ride, known as our ‘ORANGE ARMY’ (OA), are members of TEAM CLS who are dedicated to helping others. If you have had a drop out or accidentally hit a wrong key, type ‘HELP’ and they will come back and offer you a wheel back to the group.

Note: While we always try to ensure this ride is led by one of our beacons there may be some weeks where this is not possible. The ride always has regulars that will ride to the advertised pace!


WEEKLY PROGRAM
Mon  18:50 UK - Team CLS Racing - Pace ‘n’ Race: Recon and Activation 
Tues 18:50 UK - This ‘n’ That - Endurance Training
Wed  18:50 UK - Ride ‘n’ Explore Club Rideout
Thur 18:50 UK - High ‘n’ Low - Interval Training
Sat  08:50 and 14:45 UK - Base ‘n’ Banter Endurance ride
Sun  18:50 UK - Chill 'n' Spin - Weekend Social

description:

Join this Danish Based women only community on Zwift, you bring you, we will provide the energy and all the fun stuff .... Come, join us!,

description:

name: Tiny Race (1 of 4) by Zwift Insider
description:
IMPORTANT: read these notes to perform your best and avoid disqualification!

Tiny Races are mean to be raced as set of 4 back-to-back events that finish within one hour. Each race is on a different route that takes ~7-12 minutes to complete, and races are scheduled 15 minutes apart.

3 RULES:
- No skipping then returning. You will receive a DQ if you skip race 1, 2, or 3 but finish a later race in the set.
- You must have an active ZwiftPower account to compete for the overall podium.
- Smart trainer or power meter is required.

THIS WEEK'S ROUTES:
Race 1: Caldera Coaster (1 lap, 5.9km) - Powerup: Draft 
Race 2: The Watopia 150! (6.838km, ends at Lightning Lap arch) - Powerup: Aero
Race 3: Seafoam Circuit (1 lap, 4.1km) - Powerup:  Draft 
Race 4: Laps, Camera, Traction (6.6km, ends near Jungle intersection) - Powerup: Feather

PRO TIPS: 
You will receive a single powerup at the start of each race, as listed above. Be sure to visit https://zwiftinsider.com/tiny/ for details on this week's routes, including custom finish line locations.

RESULTS:
You earn points in each race based on your finishing position. The overall category winners each week (available on ZwiftPower) are the riders with the most points across all 4 races. ZwiftPower result links:
- Zone 1 (9am UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1172
- Zone 2 (3pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1173

description:
Joaquim Agostinho, 1943~1984, ciclista de elite Português. Entre muitas homenagens, sabias que sempre que sobes o ADZ, 14.ª curva do Alpe d'Huez, podes ver o Busto de J.A., em homenagem à sua vitoria desta mítica etapa no Tour em 1979, (na classificação geral terminou em 3º).

name: Madhare Saturday Hill Training
description:
Join our Madhare sessions every Tuesday and Saturday as part of our weekly Autumn/Winter training for new and experienced Zwifters.
Saturday's
Each Week you take on the MUIR AND THE MOUNTAIN...Start off settling into a rhythm for the first few weeks. Getting up and over the summit is the key. Then, start improving your time week-on-week. Start adding in some attacks whilst climbing. Before the spring you'll be attacking the climb all the way up and smashing your PB!
Our beacon is there to set a pace and to talk all things cycling so jump on and join in!
It's not a race, however, if you want to zip off ahead or drop back and relax you can do that too!
*Cat C - 1 - 5w/kg - All Cats'
Join the Mad Hare official Zwift club! Email or follow one of our leaders for an invite.

name: Newbury Velo Weekend TT
description:
NEWBURY VELO CLUB TIME TRIALS

Newbury Velo presents your weekly 10 mile TT (and a bit...). No marshals, no sign-on. No fee.

Club results will be posted on our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/newburyvelo 

Riders must be registered on https://www.zwiftpower.com and have their Zwift profile agreed to share with zwiftpower otherwise they will not be included in the results.  Think of it as the signing in process :) details of how to do this can be found here: https://boltrace.team/zwift-power-guide

THE TT HUD

Time Trials offer a unique HUD (Heads Up Display) that emphasizes that this is a race against the clock! You'll also see intermediate timing checkpoints. In Bologna, there are eight of these - one every 1km; in Watopia on the Tempus Fugit course, there are four - each one breaking up the course at a distinct landmark. A center clock timing you to 100ths of a second will keep you on task and you can use the minimap to track your progress.

CORE RULES

* Rather than having an Event start time, each rider will receive their own individual start time when signing up in Zwift Companion; you can still sign up on the web or in-game, but you won't be shown your explicit start time until you enter the paddocks.
* Drafting is disabled for all Zwift Time Trials.
* Time Trial bikes are not required. You can use any bike in your Garage.
* Results for time trials are pending until all riders have finished. You'll see other riders populate the results screen as they finish and your placing will be updated accordingly.

name: Hare & Hounds - Zwift Riders Scotland (ZRS)
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Riders Scotland 'hare and hound' handicap race:

•Join us on the last Saturday of every month to take part in a special 'chase' event.

•This is a handicap race where each group (cat A- cat D)  has a staggered start time.

•Cat D will drop first, followed by each Cat group thereafter at set intervals.

• It's a race to the finish! The first team across the line wins.

•Teamwork is crucial. Each group will need to work together to carry speed across the line (similar to TTT).

• The 4th rider for each cat group will set the time/finishing position for that team.

•Results will be shown on zwiftpower.com

•You can join a higher cat group than yours but not a lower group. For example:  if you are Cat C, you can join Cat B , but not Cat D.

•Expect a high pace during this event.  However, as per all ZRS rides, have fun and enjoy the moment!

•All riders welcome to join us on discord for some pre and post race banter on our hare and hound voice channel, please use the one associated with your  Cat Group

name: DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Special Edition Ride!

Please join us weekly on Saturdays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 120 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option.
The ride leader will stay as close to ride pace as possible. We try to change up the routes each week and some of the routes may include some small to moderate climbs.

Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.

STRAVA DIRT CLUB:

https://www.strava.com/clubs/zwiftdirt

FACEBOOK DIRT GROUP:

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftdirt

eventSubgroups.name: DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Ride (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Ride!

Please join us weekly on Saturdays at a pace of 2.8w/kg for 120 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes, same time/pace/vibe.

Saturday is a special 2 hour edition, same time/pace/vibe.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and blobbed up as a group. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option. All 505 rides come with complimentary access to an After Ride Party where you can ride extra distance with your fellow 505 teammates.

The yellow beacon team leader will ride the entirety of the ride as close to 2.8w/kg as possible. Some of the rides have a few minor climbs where the w/kg can fluctuate.

Our rides offer sweepers to help pull you back to the blob if you need assistance. Please speak up during the ride if you are in need of a sweep. No speaky, no sweepy.

Team DIRT is an acronym for Dads Indoors Riding Trainers. The 505 rides began under the Team DIRT banner. The group name “505” was created by riders in the 5:05am eastern time zone. Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.

name: Bikes – Gravel & Dust
description:
Envie de s'envoyer une bonne dose de poussière virtuelle et de transpirer ensemble ? Ce samedi, le club "Bikes" vous donne rendez-vous pour une sortie gravel exclusive sur Zwift.
Pour garder un esprit d'équipe et des conditions équitables pour tout le monde, le vélo est imposé : votre fidèle destrier est un gravel Spezialed Crux (cadre et roues typés gravel).
Au programme : de la relance, des portions vallonnées, de la poussière, de la bonne humeur et, bien sûr, l'indispensable papotage sur Discord pour ceux qui ont du souffle.
Préparez les bidons, ajustez vos cales et venez grossir le peloton des "Bikes". Qui sera de la partie ?
Discutez sur Discord: https://discord.gg/a8wYvgw
Notre Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZwiftBikes
Rejoins-nous : https://www.bikesfrance.com/
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Want to get a good dose of virtual dust and break a sweat together? This Saturday, the “Bikes” club invites you to join them for an exclusive gravel ride on Zwift.
To keep the team spirit alive and ensure a level playing field for everyone, the bike is mandatory: your trusty steed is a Spezialed Crux gravel bike (with a gravel-style frame and wheels).
On the agenda: sprints, hilly sections, dust, good vibes, and, of course, the essential chit-chat on Discord for those who still have the breath for it.
Get your water bottles ready, adjust your cleats, and come join the “Bikes” peloton. Who’s in?

name: Tiny Race (2 of 4) by Zwift Insider
description:
IMPORTANT: read these notes to perform your best and avoid disqualification!

Tiny Races are mean to be raced as set of 4 back-to-back events that finish within one hour. Each race is on a different route that takes ~7-12 minutes to complete, and races are scheduled 15 minutes apart.

3 RULES:
- No skipping then returning. You will receive a DQ if you skip race 1, 2, or 3 but finish a later race in the set.
- You must have an active ZwiftPower account to compete for the overall podium.
- Smart trainer or power meter is required.

THIS WEEK'S ROUTES:
Race 1: Caldera Coaster (1 lap, 5.9km) - Powerup: Draft 
Race 2: The Watopia 150! (6.838km, ends at Lightning Lap arch) - Powerup: Aero
Race 3: Seafoam Circuit (1 lap, 4.1km) - Powerup:  Draft 
Race 4: Laps, Camera, Traction (6.6km, ends near Jungle intersection) - Powerup: Feather

PRO TIPS: 
You will receive a single powerup at the start of each race, as listed above. Be sure to visit https://zwiftinsider.com/tiny/ for details on this week's routes, including custom finish line locations.

RESULTS:
You earn points in each race based on your finishing position. The overall category winners each week (available on ZwiftPower) are the riders with the most points across all 4 races. ZwiftPower result links:
- Zone 1 (9am UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1172
- Zone 2 (3pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1173
- Zone 3 (9pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1174

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: Xert Saturday Social – Challenge Yourself!
description:
XERT SATURDAY SOCIAL | CHALLENGE YOURSELF! 

Two pace groups. One supportive community. Challenge yourself with a safety net!
Join the Xert crew every Saturday for a 90-minute social endurance ride designed to help you build fitness throughout the winter. 
 
HOW IT WORKS
We start together with a relaxed 10-minute warmup before splitting into two pace groups:
🔵D GROUP | 2.0–2.4 W/kg
A steady endurance pace, with our leader targeting approximately 2.2 W/kg. Great for riders looking for a consistent, social ride.
🟢C GROUP | 2.6–3.0 W/kg
A faster endurance pace, with our leader targeting approximately 2.7 W/kg. Perfect for riders looking for an extra challenge!
 
CHALLENGE YOURSELF!
Normally ride with D? Try hanging on with C!  After the warmup, the C group will gradually pull ahead. Stay with them as long as you can! If you get dropped, simply ease off and let the D group catch you, then finish the ride at a more comfortable pace.
It’s a great way to challenge yourself, build fitness, and enjoy a harder effort without worrying about finishing alone.
 
SUPPORTIVE GROUP RIDING
Our D group has dedicated volunteer sweepers who will do their best to help riders who fall behind reconnect with the group. Both pace groups have dedicated leaders, so you can choose the pace that works best for you.
 
ROUTE BADGE HUNTING
We’ll rotate routes regularly to keep things interesting. We’re also planning occasional longer rides to tackle some of Zwift’s longer routes and help riders collect route badges!
 
ALL RIDERS WELCOME!
You don’t need to use Xert to participate. Whether you’re looking for a steady endurance ride or want to push yourself with a faster group, we’d love to have you join us. 
 
See you Saturday!

name: DWGZ — Hot Hundo
description:
DWGZ — Hot Hundo

Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. Many of us have zwifted together for years, and some have taken those virtual connections IRL, organizing meetups around the world. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build community, emotional endurance, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Hot Hundo is exactly what it sounds like: 100 miles, one long day in the saddle, and the second of our two weekly unlock rides — the endurance counterpart to Sunday's climbing test, Fatica Domenicale. Finish the full distance and earn your DWGZ jersey the honest way: steady pacing, deep patience, and good company from start to finish.

Whether you're chasing your first century, building serious base miles, or just want people to talk you through the back half, this one's for you.
Ride Categories 🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg 🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg 🚴 D Category – 2.0–2.6 w/kg

Expect steady pacing, deep camaraderie, and a welcoming group from yellow beacon to sweep, start to finish. Every pocket of the ride is built on teamwork, connection, and that signature DWGZ vibe.

DWGZ rides run seven days a week at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.
Clip in, fuel up, and ride the full Hundo with us.

name: HangOn Ride by Team EN
description:
Join Endurance Nation for the Hang-On Ride -- a group ride that will truly test your limits! Warm up at 2.5 W/kg for 10’, then increase to 3.5 over 10’, then 3.5+ as you are able in your group. Your mission -- to HANG ON to the faster riders! Done right, C and D riders can work to stay in the groupetto as the Bs and As push the front and try to catch any fliers right at the end. This is not a race full of surges, but there is plenty of hard work to stay in the group. Casualties are inevitable, but come back and HANG ON longer next week! We will ride for about 60k, so come prepared with lots of fluids and food. Please pay close attention to leader's instructions via message.

Join TeamEN members to chat on an app called Discord. Discord is not required, but the ride experience is enhanced by using it. Click on this link for more information about Discord and related setup: https://www.endurancenation.us/teamen-on-zwift#discord

Saturday sessions will largely be focused on developing the aerobic engine to support the upcoming race season. description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: GGCC Glasgow Green Saturday Training Ride
description:
The Glasgow Green Cycle Club GGCC group rides are training and/or social events, category C or D, with a Yellow beacon leader and Red beacon sweeper.

Please look out for our training rides on several days every week. Use #GGCC to search, as in https://zwift.com/events/tag/ggcc, or on Companion.

You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the beacon ride leader(s) for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. Our lap or distance-limited group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the Yellow beacon. Our 1-hour rides don’t close with a minirace.

GGCC is a Glasgow-based cycling club whose “in real life” (irl) club runs and training rides are always organised into pace groups, which match the Zwift categories quite well. 

As we expect our club’s riders to be able to ride 50 miles at a 15mph average on our Sunday rides, such steady riding members will be comfortable with Zwift Category C or D. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift on-screen messaging (always) and/or Discord via your headset to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals, and optionally a mini-race towards the end of our lap or distance limited rides, with regrouping after each segment. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and intervals.

Results can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we publish your results on zwiftpower.com too, based on each category.

All bikes and PUs are allowed, but better not to use TT bikes (which don’t draft) on our group rides. Please add GGCC (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognised, where X is your desired ride category. Categories are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg, then pick the correct ride and group.

Category D: 2 W/kg to 2.5 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average or below.
Category C: 2.6 W/kg to 3.2 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 3.2w/kg pace average or below.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.

You can use our GGCC Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/UDhdEQA.

Please see the GGCC Zwift page link at http://www.glasgowgreencycleclub.co.uk/ for more.

For more about specific Zwift courses for our events, see the Zwift Companion schedule, and also https://zwiftinsider.com/ where there is a wealth of information about all things Zwift.

Get out the blocks fast and try to hold on to the fastest group you can. Use the draft to hold on to riders who are stronger than you normally. We will always use nice flat courses to race on but beware we may soometimes use event finishes based on distance and not traditional lap endings.
Race it or take it easy, its your choice. Either way, you’ll end the ride with the prize of a shiny new Atom Racing Team in game kit for your garage.
If you like what you see, come and join us in our Zwift club or join us for real by searching for our Facebook group.

name: SROZ's Ride 'n Shine
description:
The Striders and Riders of Zwift's “Ride ‘n Shine” is a social ride where community comes first.

We pride ourselves on a friendly, respectful, and supportive atmosphere...perfect for those looking for a great workout and even better company.

The terrain might get a little spicy at times, but we aim for that sweet-spot average of 18–20 mph (30–32 kph).

Stick with the leader’s peloton! We’re better together...plus, you’ll save a ton of energy by tucking into that group draft.

Feeling a little gapped? Don't sweat it. We strive to have a dedicated sweeper on every ride to help pull you back into the fold.

The "Gene Autry" Philosophy: We believe in freedom! As the legend himself said, we won’t fence you in.

At the end of the day, you’re the captain of your own bike. Whether you’re pushing the pace or soaking in the scenery: ride your ride!

So come out, enjoy the virtual fresh air, and keep the faith!

eventSubgroups.name: SROZ's Ride 'n Shine (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
The Striders and Riders “Ride ‘n Shine” Casual, Social Ride is a group ride in a friendly, supportive, respectful, and enjoyable atmosphere. 🎉🚴🏻‍♂️😁

The pace may vary depending on the course, but we strive to ride and socialize with an overall average pace of approximately 18-20mph (30-32kph).  

Please be prepared to ride with the group leader’s peloton, so everyone benefits from the group draft effect. 

We will try to have a sweeper on each ride to help any rider who may want to return to the group. 

Remember, the choice is yours…ride your ride!

So, enjoy your ride, keep the faith, and become that someone!

name: Moxie Ride
description: Moxie Ride is a progressive w/k based ride. Increased effort every 30 minutes by .25 w/k, with the first 30 minutes at 2.25w/k. The ride is 2hours.

name: Team CRYO-GEN Saturday Social!
description:
Join Team CRYO-GEN for a laid-back, social spin every Saturday! We roll for 90 minutes at a friendly D-pace (1.8–2.5 w/kg), perfect for steady endurance, recovery, or just soaking up the good vibes. Whether you’re training, chatting, or just enjoying the ride, you’re in great company here.

Each week, we’ll mix things up with a rotating course, keeping the scenery fresh and the legs guessing. No power-ups needed and no pressure—just a great group of riders and a solid session to kick off your weekend.

Keep it smooth, stay together, and ride on with Team CRYO-GEN!

name: Pretzels, Epics and Afterparties p/b Velos
description:
October 🥨 RIDES
Each week in October, we'll be visiting a different route on Zwift, taking on one of the epic Zwift rides. This month we'll be throwing in routes with lots of climbs, some sprints and plenty of KOMs, should you choose to speed and regroup.
Although the ride officially stops at 2 hours, we strongly encourage you to carry on for the after party, and bag that route badge.
Pick your intensity wisely, 2.0w/kg (red beacon) will be zone 2 for many cat C riders, 2.5w/kg (yellow beacon) is zone 2 for moderate to high cat B riders (or choose to push your w/kg a bit higher by using a MTB).
The Velos jersey is unassigned during this event but you will unlock it if you complete the 2 hour ride, please wear our jersey to show your support if you have it in your garage🙏. Long rides can drag on your own, so jump in, and Team Velos will help the time fly past with the friendly chat and questionable jokes. Don't forget to grab a bidon or two, and bring some snacks!

Classic Championship.

Week 1: The Stampede
Our ITT format, pick your best TT-bike to set the fastest time possible.

Week 2: Herd Winter Racing (also known as Herd Beginner Racing)
A mass start scratch race. Find your group and race them to the finishline.

Week 3: Herd of Mountain Goats
Climbing, lots and lots of climbing.

Week 4: Bullseye Point Race
First across the line points racing. Beat everyone to the line to score the most points.

Week 5: Climbers Gambit
Our Hill Climb event. Only your time on the climb segment counts.

Week 6: Herd Summer Racing League
It’s not really summer anymore, but we’re always in for a good FTS points race.

As a part of the trip down memory lane we’re letting everyone weigh in on the courses that
will be used. So if you want your vote to count join the Herd Racing facebook page:

name: GC Coaching's Amalgam
description:
GC Coaching's structured group workouts are geared towards athletes in
their base phase, so if you are looking for a Hammerfest, this isn't your
ride. These workouts are focused on building aerobic capacity and will
consist of mainly zone 2-4 riding, with some zone 5 sprinkled in at times
for good measure. We will also be mixing up the power, cadence, and
position on the bike throughout the course of the workout further challenge
your basic skills and on-bike flexibility. Come and join us!

*BIO*:
Shayne holds a bachelors degree in Health Science in Professional
Development and Advanced Patient Care, is a licensed physical therapy
assistant in Massachusetts, a USA Cycling Level 1 (expert level) certified
Coach, a USA Cycling Power Based Training Certified Coach, a Precision
Nutrition Level 1 Certified Coach, a US Military Endurance Sports (USMES)
affiliated Coach, and USA Olympic Committee Safe Sport certified.

He is the owner and head Coach of GC Coaching, Workout Content Editor at
Zwift, the creator of P2 Coached Computraining, and the creator of Zwift’s
“Build Me Up”, "Pebble Pounder", and “201: Your First 5k” Flexible Training
Plans. He has also been involved with Zwift Academy since 2019.

As an award-winning author, he has been published in Bicycling Magazine,
the TrainingPeaks blog, Zwift Insider, and hosts the Never Going Pro
podcast.

He can be reached directly through the GC Coaching website for questions
and coaching inquiries: https://gccoaching.fit/

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

The focus of this, indoor, basic endurance ride, is to complete an extended
duration steady-state bout at a low intensity but with focussed blocks of

Although intervals are zoned and you can use ERG mode on Zwift we recommend

name: The BMTR Fundo
description:
The BMTR Fundo is a personal challenge that focuses on distance and/or time. Some participants may treat the event like a race, while others may take a more casual approach, with the primary goal of completing the distance.

Ultimately, this event is about getting on your bike, connecting with others, and enjoying the journey. The speed at which you ride, as well as the distance you choose, is entirely your decision!

Usually, several hundred Zwifters take part, and everyone starts at the same time, creating many opportunities to form groups and ride together along the route.

Although this event isn't considered an “official” race, results will be published for participants who choose to treat it as one.


**Categories/Groups**
In the BMTR Fundo, groups A, B, C, and D do not reflect riders' strength, ability, or fitness levels. Instead, these groups are categorized by distance. The average Watts per Kilogram (W/KG) range for each category is set to 1.0-5.0 W/KG, since each distance will include riders of varying abilities.


**Distances**
The BMTR Fundo features four distances from 26 to 100 miles, all on the same route and starting at the same time.

name: Phoenix Rising Soaring Saturday
description:
Please join us on Soaring Saturday and leave all your worries at the door to your pain cave/riding room. We welcome riders who like to go long on the weekend.

The yellow beacon will endeavor to ride at a pace of between 1.5 and 2.0 w/kg. The activation of the no-kick fence will be at the yellow beacon's discretion and used only as a guide for newer riders to let them know they're leaving the main group behind – the objective of the ride, as with all our group rides, is to share a little longer time together and enjoy the camaraderie. We employ a fab group of sweepers to accompany and/or help riders rejoin the main yellow group. We intend that no one ride alone unless they want to do so.

We will ride a variety of routes, hoping to tackle some of the longer and more challenging routes in Zwift so the ride will generally be 120 minutes in length but occasionally be set for distance to allow for a specific route badge. We will not shy away from climbs or non paved surfaces. If you don't have time to complete the longer route(s), you may always leave the ride without quitting it and come back later to complete the route.

For more information on all our weekly events, join our club Phoenix Rising on Zwift Companion.

name: Ride to End ALZ
description:
The Ride to End ALZ South Carolina is a three-day, cross-state journey for cycling enthusiasts. Now in its 17th year, the unique Group Ride travels from beautiful Upstate South Carolina to the picturesque Charleston coast July 11-13, 2025. Riders may choose between two mileage options: The Grand Tour (257 miles) or The Half Tour (136 miles). This event is known for its incredible support along the route and camaraderie that only a multi-day ride can bring. Participants may also ride at their own pace from anywhere in our month-long Virtual Challenge. Either way, funds raised by riders benefit the Alzheimer's Association and fuel cutting-edge research targeted to change the trajectory of Alzheimer’s disease. Get all the details at alz.org/ridesc
This ride is open to everyone and all paces- the lead beacon will maintain a steady average D to C pace, and our red beacon will lead a second pace group if necessary! Our goal is to fill you in on the details of the incredible impact Ride to End ALZ has on making progress towards the research and treatment of Alzheimers through funding with the Alzheimer’s Association. In addition to the 3-day Group Ride in SC, there is also a month-long Virtual Challenge option! Join us, unlock the Ride to End ALZ kit, and learn more about how YOU can make a difference in the fight against Alzheimer’s! Join our Facebook group to get all the latest info: https://www.facebook.com/groups/alzRTR

More details at alz.org/ridesc

name: USMeS Task Force 100
description:
Welcome to USMeS Task Force 100 - Your Weekly Long-Distance Mission
100 Miles on the first Saturday of each month, 100km on all other Saturdays
Every Saturday, we go long. If you’re ready to build serious endurance, this weekly rotation keeps the challenge high and the mileage real. If you’re looking for flat terrain….sorry, but our rides didn’t get that memo 😉

100 Miles (First Saturday each month)
The big one…the Imperial Century.
Time to settle in, fuel well, and grind out 100 miles / 162 km in one steady effort.
Beacons: Two yellow beacons guiding the groups
Fence: No fence—ride your pace, push your limits

100km Ride (All other Saturdays)
The weekly grinder.
Perfect for endurance building
Ride with the group for 100 km / 62 miles at a smooth, social, consistent pace.
Beacons: Two yellow beacons guiding the groups
Fence: No fence—ride your pace, push your limits

Ride Format
✅Pure endurance—steady, smooth, social miles
✅No pressure—ride the full 100 km / 100 miles or stay as long as you want
✅No fence. Flyers are welcome to fly and everyone is encouraged to choose a sustainable group
✅No scheduled breaks, but coffee refuels every 30 minutes

Expectations
✅Respect all riders—everyone’s here for distance
✅Pace smart—whether 100 km or 100 miles, it’s endurance, not a sprint
✅Support and encourage others as the miles stack up

This is more than a ride. It’s a weekly test of stamina, patience, and love for the long haul.

Because #weareneverflat

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck
www.usmilitaryesports.com

name: AM:WATTS Weekly Zwift Ride Series
description:
Welcome to Black Watts AM:WATTS Weekly Zwift Ride Series with Chris (aka Tron_Rides).

Whether you’re chasing fitness, new friends, or just great vibes, AM:WATTS is your Saturday morning reset. Expect steady pacing, good banter, and that perfect mix of challenge and fun that keeps you coming back week after week. If you want to push major watts, there’s space for you too.  We welcome every rider.

How to Join: Join BLACK WATTS club on the Zwift Companion App

Ride Dynamics
The first 15 minutes are a group warm-up and we’ll stay together, chat, and settle in. After that, you can join one of two pacing groups:
• YB (Yellow Beacon): Ride Leader pace, ~2.5 w/kg and under
• FYT (Find Your Tribe): Ride your own pace...get in where you fit in!

Coffee Stop
If you need a short break during the ride, use Coffee Stop from the bottom menu after 30 minutes, and again every 30 minutes after that. Coffee Stop will be disabled within 5 km of the finish.

name: Alpe 70 & 85 min Pace & Chase 50/45/40 😈🍍
description:
As Zwift is a great community Torturefest Cult & Team GIANT are collaborating to help you get stronger.

For the Torturefest rides we have added a Twist, stronger riders will be chasing you down. Start times are set so they can catch you in the final segments.

Pen E is the advertised paced ride with beacons
Pen D is a 85 min pace (beacons not guaranteed)
Pen C is the 50 minute pace chase (beacons not guaranteed)
Pen B is the 45 minute pace chase (beacons not guaranteed)
Pen A is the sub 40 minute pace (beacons not guaranteed)

Alpe Paced Rides

Wanna build your Alpe pace but want a wheel to follow?
Join our rides where our beacons will pace you at 4 different advertised
paces across 4 rolling weekends, 2 paces per weekend at 8am CT and 9.30 am CT.

Hold pace until ya crack, then come back again and get to extend the cracking point.

We deliver Personal Records / Bests.

The goal is to build up to the magic sub 60 mins for Alpe, faster and slower riders are always welcome.

This is a rolling 4-week schedule

Weekend #1
8.00 am CT 60 min pace & Chase - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 75 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #2
8.00 am CT 65 min pace & Chase - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 70 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #3
8.00 am CT 70 min pace & Chase - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 65 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #4
8.00 am CT 75 min pace & Chase - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 60 min pace - Team GIANT

Pro tips

Look at your best Alpe time on Strava, there will be a segment for the entire climb with average watts for the entire climb. Beating that average watts number by 5 watts each segment is your goal for each segment.

Use all the tools in the toolbox:
• Cardiovascular = Seated higher rpm
• Legs = Seated low rpm – Great for the knees!!!
• Legs = Standing low rpm – You will crack

We go warm for the first 25%, a steady pace for the until 75% and push at the end. Start out too hot and you’ll suffer at the top.

name: Bike MS - Banded Community Challenge
description:
Bike MS Season if right around the corner, so let's connect over a ride as we prepare for the adventures ahead. Multiple Sclerosis does not stop, so neither will we as we ride together for this great cause.
Our monthly events are mirrored after the Bike MS Rides hosted by the National MS Society in which each day riders can choose their own adventure and challenge. Whatever distance ride you choose, come join a group of passionate cyclists looking to raise funds and awareness for those living with multiple sclerosis. All Zwift riders are welcome as we ride for a world free of MS. We hope you enjoy the ride and if so, please join Bike MS Zwift Club for year round training and community engagement. Come for the miles of smiles and stay for the XP. 
Bike MS is the largest charity cycling series across the United States consisting of 50 rides and raising over $50 million in 2023 for the National MS Society. Bike MS supports the National MS Society's mission to Cure MS while empowering all people affected by MS to live their best lives. Whether you want to cross the Finish Line in person or take on a new challenge from anywhere — there’s a Bike MS event that’s right for you! 
Check out www.bikeMS.org and experience the ride of your life. Use Zwift24 for a discount on your Bike MS Ride entry fee.
Come join us for weekly Club Rides: Bike MS ZC
#dontjustride #bikeMS #whateverittakes #strongertogether

name: Triathletes on Zwift Saturday Endurance Workout
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This workout is part of a 30-week progressive series that builds from tempo to sub threshold focused workout efforts.  The aim of this series is to build riders long ride aerobic abilities, specifically to enable them to effectively get off the bike prepared to run.  Total ride time over the 24 build series weeks will extend from 1hr :15 min up to 3 hours.  As workouts get longer we will incorporate higher effort/shorter duration intervals (super threshold work) into the program after the main set.  These workouts are perfect for long course focused triathletes along with anyone interested in developing their abilities to ride for longer periods of time.  Each of the 24-week workouts builds off the preceding workout in terms of duration of main set intervals and total ride time.

WORKOUT DESIGNER

AJ Baucco is a well established professional triathlete from Cleveland, Ohio. He founded AJ Baucco Coaching, which has coached over 150 triathletes in the last 5 years. He also manages 3 different age group triathlon teams; The Baucco Squad, TRS Racing, and Team INFINIT Performance. Over the years, AJ Baucco has become a premier triathlon coach. He has helped athletes achieve personal bests, stand on podiums, and even race world championship events. On the race course, AJ Baucco has achieved top results at every distance from super sprint to Ironman. Most recently, he was on the winning team for 6 different Major League Triathlon events, and 2 back to back series championships.

Contact – 
Websites – www.baucco.com, www.ajbcoaching.com, www.bauccosquad.com
Twitter - @irunshirtless
Instagram - @ajbaucco

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins.  Everyone stays together regardless of power output.   That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other.  Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

HELPFUL HINT

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.   

For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

Welcome to the ZLDR Weekly Long Run. ZLDR is a group of diverse runners, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. name: Group Run 5k
description:
DESCRIPTION

Join us for a 5k group run.   It's run-at-your-own-pace and all are welcome! 

Pick the closest pace group for you, but all groups will start together and you are free to fall back and run ahead. The pace groups designate average pace for the duration of the run. Most groups will start slower and finish faster than the indicated pace. Feel free to mix in some intervals and race your friends.

name: DIRT Dadurday Chase Race
description:
Welcome to the DIRT Dadurday Chase Race.

Race category starts will be staggered with the E category starting first, and each D, C, B, and A category starting later.

The riders will be challenged to work together using the draft, and group tactics in order to catch the category ahead of them while also holding off the categories that started after. 

Races will have 4 power-ups enabled with equal odds (25% each): 
draft, feather, burrito, & ghost! 
Compete with the best, and see how you stack up!

You must be opted-in on Zwift.com & ZwiftPower.com to be counted for race results.
We highly encourage A racers to follow Zwift eRacing Ruleset.
Dual recording of trainer & power meter, and recent weigh-in on ZwifTransparency 
recommended--we reserve the right to ask for this information to verify outstanding 
performances.

Categories are based on Zwift Racing Score:
A: 800 - 1000
B: 600 - 800
C: 400 - 600
D: 200 - 400
E: 0 - 200

name: Team CLS Base 'n' Banter
description:
Base ’n’ Banter is a controlled weekend endurance ride - with a strong community and social focus! 

Across every weekend in 2026, we will continue to offer a mix of rides that cover flat, rolling and hilly terrain with the aim of getting in a solid endurance ride, mostly around 2hrs.

This is a chance to enjoy a friendly experienced group club ride with regulars who have no Big Egos. While you build your fitness, there is always plenty of in-ride banter. 

What pace to expect?
We will ride the flats around 2.5 - 2.7 w/kg with a focus on keeping everyone together!

The leader will climb at around 3.0 - 3.2 w/kg depending on the length and if needed we will always try and regroup after.

While the leader will do everything to keep everyone together, we can't slow repeatedly so some splits are inevitable.

Our SWEEPERS on this ride, known as our ‘ORANGE ARMY’ (OA), are members of TEAM CLS who are dedicated to helping others. If you have had a drop out or accidentally hit a wrong key, type ‘HELP’ and they will come back and offer you a wheel back to the group.

Note: While we always try to ensure this ride is led by one of our beacons there may be some weeks where this is not possible. The ride always has regulars that will ride to the advertised pace!

name: CCBoucherville-V2000 FUN Races
description:
Club Cycliste Boucherville (CCB) in Quebec (Canada) is a non-profit organization to promote cycling as a social and healthy lifestyle. We help kids to acquire the knowledge and skills that will allow to develop themselves as cyclists. Although we prioritize the pleasure at training, we also make sure to support those who wish to participate in races, regardless of the objectives. Young riders can join us from the age of 5... as long as they want to have fun on two wheels. The first year, we can even provide them with a bike for free - thanks to Vélo-2000 Garneau Concept (https://velo2000.qc.ca/)).

This weekly race is meant to be an opportunity to ride and have fun with teammates and opponents during the cold season, and meet passionate cyclists from around the world.

Race your category (based on your best estimation of your FTP/kg).

- A: 4.0W/kg and OVER (Red Circle Icon)  --  3 laps
- B: 3.2W/kg to 3.99W/kg (Green Circle Icon)  --  3 laps
- C: 2.5W/kg to 3.19W/kg (Blue Circle Icon)  --  2 laps
- D: UNDER 2.5W/kg (Yellow Circle Icon)  --  1 lap

Be prepared for 1, 2 or 3 laps (around 10 km each). The course is relatively flat. Start strong and grab a good wheel.

All bikes allowed

PowerUp allowed

Heart Rate Monitor recommended

Unfair and unsporting behaviour prohibited

Fun and Lactate mandatory

Results will be available here and on zwiftpower.com. These races do not count towards any league standings.

Join us on our Discord Channel (https://discord.gg/DZDVFVhto) to discuss your race strategy during the warm-up… and chat during the race if you have enough energy. Use the GENERAL channel, or discuss more privately with your Bike Club teammates in your respective channel. Welcome to French- and English-speaking riders. Please use push-to-talk. 

Please visit our website https://clubcyclisteboucherville.com/ and our FaceBook page https://www.facebook.com/clubcyclisteboucherville/ to share pictures, comments and suggestions.

Ride Hard. Have Fun.

#sympatique #CCB #velo2000 #FunRace

name: Alpe 75 min Pace 😈🍍
description:
As Zwift is a great community Torturefest Cult & Team GIANT are collaborating
to help you get stronger.

Wanna build your Alpe pace but want a wheel to follow?
Join our rides where our beacons will pace you at 4 different advertised paces across 4 rolling weekends, 2 paces per weekend at 8am CT and 9.30am CT.

We do have unofficial slower and faster paces just ask in the pen and if we have available pacers we will pace a 2nd pace as well.

Hold pace until ya crack, then come back again and get to extend the cracking point. 
We deliver Personal Records / Bests.

The goal is to build up to the magic sub 60 mins for Alpe, faster and slower riders are always welcome.

This is a rolling 4-week schedule 

Weekend #1
8.00 am CT 60 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 75 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #2
8.00 am CT 65 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 70 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #3
8.00 am CT 70 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 65 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #4
8.00 am CT 75 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 60 min pace - Team GIANT


Pro tips

1) Look at your best Alpe time on Strava, there will be a segment for the
entire climb with average watts for the entire climb. Beating that average watt
number by 5 watts each segment is your goal for each segment.

2) Use all the tools in the toolbox:

• Cardiovascular = Seated higher rpm

• Legs = Seated low rpm – Great for the knees!!!!

• Legs = Standing low rpm – You will crack

3) We go warm for the first 25%, a steady pace for the until 75% and push
at the end, start out to hot you’ll suffer at the top.

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: Bicycle Way of Life Saturday Ride
description:
Bicycle Way of Life Saturday Morning 100K

This group ride is not a race, rather it is a ride intended as a D level opportunity for a metric century.  Our pace can best be described as endurance pace, typically on a relatively flat course.  We always plan to provide lead and sweep support, but there will be times where that will not be the case.  You are encouraged to pace with the ride leader/yellow beacon, but if they are not able to make the ride, or if you find the pace too quick, drop off, group up, work together and find your way to 100K.  Teamwork makes this ride work.
 
Want to know more about us? Bicycle Way of Life (bicycleway.com) is a local bike store chain in Eugene, Oregon. We encourage new and experienced riders to support each other indoors and out, fixing trails or just their bikes.
Interact and find more info. by joining our FB group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/bwolzwift
Look us up on Strava https://www.strava.com/clubs/bicycleway-com, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/bicyclewayoflife/, and Facebook https://www.facebook.com/bicycleway/

description:

This group ride is an introduction to indoor riding & training for those new to the virtual world. The Saris mission is to break down barriers so that everyone has access to fall in love with the bike. These rides are an unintimidating gateway into the world of virtual riding.

name: NoPinz R3R - 60km Race
description:
Welcome to this NoPinz R3R Race. The rules are simple....
Please use ZwiftPower's Minimum Category on your profile for race entry.
Cats A, and B will require a power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor.
Cat C will require power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor for podium spots.
Podium finishers in Cat A are expected to dual (power) record and to make analysis publicly available on ZwiftPower; they must also be using a direct drive trainer or power meter.
**Elite level performances are also expected to be supported by dual (power) recordings from reputable power sources or easily verifiable outside data. This applies to those with a history of such performances.
** 5.2 w/kg (20 mins); 6 w/kg (5 mins); 9.8 w/kg (1 min)
Zwift Activities must be saved publicly.
Please also maintain an open and active Strava profile to facilitate organiser inquiry.
Please see http://www.zwiftpower.com for finalised race results. The race is brought to you by NoPinz please visit https://nopinz.com/product-tag/subzero/ All subzero kit can be custom made in any design.

name: The HERD Rehab Ride
description:
This is a banded ride so the group can stay together and support riders new to Zwift, or recovering from sickness, or injuries. The ride leader, the Yellow Beacon, will ride at the advertised pace and, unless you stop pedaling, the group will stay together as if held together by a rubber band. Those wishing to ride faster/harder may certainly do so but THIS IS NOT A RACE! We ride together as a Herd. Clean "Dad Jokes" are encouraged!
Have fun.

eventSubgroups.name: The HERD Rehab Ride (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
New to Zwift, just a little out of shape or recovering from injury? This is the group ride for you! All are welcome to join The Herd on this supportive and social event.

Respect the leader's pace and ride with the yellow beacon. This is NOT A RACE! Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back.

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/Dr7ZtPV (Please use Push-To-Talk)
Check us out on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerd/

#herd

name: LGBTQz Chase the Rainbows
description:
LGBTQ Zwifters are delighted to host our monthly chase race where you will join other racers in your pace category. We aim for a fun, inclusive and social event and everyone is welcome. Categories will leave the pen with a time delay between them; D cat will leave first, followed by C cat, B cat and finally A cat!  Can you work together to chase the rainbows in front, or keep the chasing rainbows at bay?

Join us on Discord to join your race category voice channel for maximum fun and cooperation! (https://discord.gg/Vb86DSUvTY)

Learn more about LGBTQ Zwifters at https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: T-VGN 🌱 Sprout & Sprint
description: Welcome to Team Vegan’s Sunday Sprout & Sprint race. This is a chance to test yourself with race events each week. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

name: OWL.BiKe Women's Grey Zone: Meet. Play. Ride.
description:
This is your weekly space to meet, play, and ride together while we spin in the sweet spot of the Grey Zone. Our rubber-banded rides keep things inclusive and welcoming, so no one gets dropped—just a smooth, social ride at an easy pace.

But this isn’t just a ride. Along the way, we bring in a playful, gamified quiz experience designed to spark conversation, curiosity, and connection. Topics range from light and fun to meaningful and empowering, with a focus on celebrating and uplifting women.

Come for the ride, stay for the vibe—this is where community, conversation, and movement meet.

name: Chaser the Pacer!
description:
This is a different type of chase event.

Everyone has to complete one lap of Mountain Mash - only 5.7km.

Every category is led by a Robo Pacer, configured so that their power output is at the top end of the pace group. They are all set up so that they should finish *extremely* closely together.

Jump into your category and try to keep up with the pacer and see how near to the front you finish!

name: SYN CLUB CIRCUIT IRL
description:
Join us on 31 October when the SYN CLUB CIRCUIT goes live IRL. Get on your bike and ride alongside the community—from the event floor in Chemnitz to your own home setup.

You’ve got the kit—now it’s time for the final push to empty the tank with our quick-fire rides, no matter where you choose to ride.

Chase the finish line, ride for the fun of it, and be part of the circuit wherever you are.

name: Velos Race Of Truth
description:
This energy-sapping event pits riders against each other in a race they cycle alone. The individual time trial is referred to as the 'race of truth' because it reveals your own strength without the aid of draft from fellow riders. With breakneck speed valued above everything else, prepare to be amazed by this fast-paced spectacle.

Race Rules and Information
Race the same course each month to easily establish your improvement each week.
Riders will enter the category allowed by Zwift category Enforcement.
TT Bikes only
Only Riders in your category will be visible and without any draft. Z power and riders without heart rate monitors will be removed from the results.
Completing the race will unlock the Team Velos kit.

Join our community at www.teamvelos.co.uk

name: Vikings of Valhalla Run
description: Welcome to the Team Valhalla group run. Join us on 5 km running with Valhalla Vikings. Please join us weekly on Saturday afternoons for a 5km/h - 10km/h run. We are using yellow beacon that you can follow while running! The only rule we have is to HAVE FUN! For more information about our rides and runs please go to https://www.facebook.com/groups/503388660165279 or https://www.skaal.cc

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: USMeS Ridgeline Assault
description:
Welcome to USMeS Ridgeline Assault! Where Saturdays are earned one climb at a time!!
This is a climbing-focused ride built for riders who want sustained elevation, steady pressure, and the freedom to push hard when the road tilts up. Routes change week to week, but the mission stays the same...commit to the climb and see what you’ve got.

✅Average Pace: 2.5–5.0 w/kg (choose your effort)
✅Duration: 60 minutes

2 Yellow Beacons
⚡️ Lead Beacon - spicier pace off the front
⚡️ Secondary beacon — pacing the advertised effort
🚫 No fence — ride where it makes sense for you

Ride Format
✅Climb heavy routes with sustained efforts on the ascents
✅A focused, supportive environment where hard work is expected

Expectations
✅Climbing is honest work.
✅Respect all riders, ride your pace, and stay engaged.
✅Every summit counts, and every effort adds up.

When the climbing is done, spin it out and recover with the Sunday Endurance Ride. The perfect way to reset after the assault.
Find your line. Hold it to the top.

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck
www.usmilitaryesports.com

name: Gravel Mountain Paced Rides
description:
Join us as we carry out some group rides on the Red Rock Loop route in Gravel Mountain.

Choose your group depending on the pace you would like to ride at.

Since 2007, athletes from 65 different countries have been racing the Ultimate Singletrack Adventure in British Columbia, Canada and now, BC Bike Race is bringing you a new experience to Zwift.

The BC Bike Race Endurance Workout is a weekly ride designed to help build your endurance during the winter months in preparation for the summer to shred singletrack.

name: Team Italy Burn Calories Together!
description:
Team Italy – Burning Calories Together is a welcoming social group ride where we keep things fun and supportive. The lead yellow beacon sets a steady pace between 1.5–2.0 w/kg and keeps the group together using the fence. Our sweeper also carries a yellow beacon to ensure all messages of help and encouragement are clearly visible to every rider. Together our ride leaders, supported by ITA friends, make sure no one is left behind.
It’s a relaxed atmosphere with plenty of friendly chat where riders look out for each other. Whether you’re building fitness, spinning the legs, or just enjoying good company, this ride is for everyone — so come share the fun and burn calories together!

Team Italy – Burning Calories Together è una pedalata di gruppo sociale e accogliente, pensata per divertirsi e sostenersi a vicenda. Il leader, con beacon giallo, mantiene un’andatura costante tra 1,5 e 2,0 w/kg e tiene il gruppo compatto utilizzando la fence. Anche lo sweeper avrà il Beacon giallo, così tutti i messaggi di aiuto e incoraggiamento saranno chiaramente visibili a ogni partecipante. Insieme, i nostri leader, supportati dagli amici ITA, faranno in modo che nessuno venga lasciato indietro.
L’atmosfera sarà rilassata, con una chat piacevole, e i ciclisti si prenderanno cura gli uni degli altri. Che tu stia migliorando la forma fisica, sciogliendo le gambe o semplicemente godendoti la buona compagnia, questa pedalata è per tutti — quindi vieni a condividere il divertimento e a bruciare calorie insieme!

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 39K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: Run In The Park
description:
Come and join the original Zwift group run! 

This event is a 5km mass start event and runs at multiple times every Saturday.  

It is open to runners of all abilities so whether you are a recreational runner or an elite athlete you are welcome on the start line.  

Get to the start gates early to chat with the other runners, you may find someone of a similar ability to group up with for the run.  

There is no time limit for completing the event so run at your own pace and enjoy the course.

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Four Horsemen | Week 4
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Rollers Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Rollers Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: PACK Run Hill Training: Surrey
description:
PACK Beginner Hill Training is a group workout designed to help runners get familiar with running with incline. This is a free run event meaning there is no set pace you must go, but there will be incline prompts that attempt to mimic the terrain of the course. The inclines are based on distance, so you will always be given prompts based on your progression in the workout. If some of the gradients are too challenging for you, feel free to decrease the incline, but don't make it too easy. The leader will typically follow the pace chart below, but may adjust depending on the group dynamics.

Note: We will not always be matching Zwift gradients, so it is important to pay attention to the instructions. Typically the adjusted incline will be half of what is being displayed in the upper righthand corner.

As a general guide: 
--------------------------
0 - 1% = 10.2kph / 6.3 mph
2% - 9.9 kph / 6.2 mph
3% = 9.7 kph / 6.0 mph
4% = 9.3 kph / 5.8 mph 
5% = 9 kph / 5.6 mph
6% = 8.7 kph / 5.4 mph
7% = 7.4 kph / 5.2 mph
--------------------------

If you'd like Zwift to record your elevation in the fit file, you'll need to either have a direct connect treadmill or use an app like Pascal's Runcline for iOS, TSS app for iOS, or Runn module from North Pole Engineering.

Finally, if the hills don't wear you out, there will be an optional 500 meter sprint to the finish and optional after party of 2-4km to boot!

So put PACK in your name, get your black shirt and shorts on, and let's tackle those hills!

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftpack/

name: Herd Classics #3 - Herd of Mountain Goats
description:
Herd Classics: six weeks, six different races.

This year Herd Racing is taking all their best races and putting them in one big competition.
Take on legendary Zwift courses while going on a trip down memory lane. Each week brings
us a new challenge and each week we will crown an overall and Herd Racing champion in
all categories. For the hardcore racers that will be joining us each week there is also a Herd
Classic Championship.

Week 1: The Stampede
Our ITT format, pick your best TT-bike to set the fastest time possible.

Week 2: Herd Winter Racing (also known as Herd Beginner Racing)
A mass start scratch race. Find your group and race them to the finishline.

Week 3: Herd of Mountain Goats
Climbing, lots and lots of climbing.

Week 4: Bullseye Point Race
First across the line points racing. Beat everyone to the line to score the most points.

Week 5: Climbers Gambit
Our Hill Climb event. Only your time on the climb segment counts.

Week 6: Herd Summer Racing League
It’s not really summer anymore, but we’re always in for a good FTS points race.

As a part of the trip down memory lane we’re letting everyone weigh in on the courses that
will be used. So if you want your vote to count join the Herd Racing facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

name: JETT Endurance Ride 100km 2.5~3.3w/kg
description:
JETT Endurance Ride !!
Let's ride 2.5w/kg~3.3w/kg !!
B category's average of power is 3.0~3.3w/kg, start is 2.5w/kg for grouping.
C category's average of power is 2.5~2.9w/kg, start is 2.0w/kg for grouping.

Double draft is on.

Rule of this group ride
· You always keep grouping in mind
· Do not Lead from Leader - yellow beacon
· Keep stay around Yellow Beacon
· TT Bike is allowed but TT bike cant get drafting effect.
· If you exceed the Fence, return to Yellow Beacon at 2.0w/kg or less.

*There are several Sweepers on this group ride. If you have dropped, please
request 'Help' in ZWIFT Chat if you need help. A sweeper goes for help.
However, we can not help without the offer of 'HElp'.

Follow endurance ride for 2 hours and 30 minutes, follow leader
instructions and enjoy ZWIFT chat, let's work together and make the best
group, the best workout!

name: Run In The Park
description:
Come and join the original Zwift group run! 

This event is a 5km mass start event and runs at multiple times every Saturday.  

It is open to runners of all abilities so whether you are a recreational runner or an elite athlete you are welcome on the start line.  

Get to the start gates early to chat with the other runners, you may find someone of a similar ability to group up with for the run.  

There is no time limit for completing the event so run at your own pace and enjoy the course.

name: Tiny Race (1 of 4) by Zwift Insider
description:
IMPORTANT: read these notes to perform your best and avoid disqualification!

Tiny Races are mean to be raced as set of 4 back-to-back events that finish within one hour. Each race is on a different route that takes ~7-12 minutes to complete, and races are scheduled 15 minutes apart.

3 RULES:
- No skipping then returning. You will receive a DQ if you skip race 1, 2, or 3 but finish a later race in the set.
- You must have an active ZwiftPower account to compete for the overall podium.
- Smart trainer or power meter is required.

THIS WEEK'S ROUTES:
Race 1: Caldera Coaster (1 lap, 5.9km) - Powerup: Draft 
Race 2: The Watopia 150! (6.838km, ends at Lightning Lap arch) - Powerup: Aero
Race 3: Seafoam Circuit (1 lap, 4.1km) - Powerup:  Draft 
Race 4: Laps, Camera, Traction (6.6km, ends near Jungle intersection) - Powerup: Feather

PRO TIPS: 
You will receive a single powerup at the start of each race, as listed above. Be sure to visit https://zwiftinsider.com/tiny/ for details on this week's routes, including custom finish line locations.

RESULTS:
You earn points in each race based on your finishing position. The overall category winners each week (available on ZwiftPower) are the riders with the most points across all 4 races. ZwiftPower result links:
- Zone 1 (9am UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1172
- Zone 2 (3pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1173
- Zone 3 (9pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1174
